requirements.statement: CC.EN is a read-write bit with reset value zero; setting it enables command processing and clearing it initiates Controller Reset.
While CC.EN is zero, the controller shall not process commands or post completion queue entries.
Controller Reset caused by clearing CC.EN does not affect the Admin Queue properties AQA, ASQ, or ACQ.
Admin Queue properties AQA, ASQ, and ACQ are only allowed to be modified while CC.EN is zero.
After CC.EN is set, CSTS.RDY becomes one when ready to process; after CC.EN is cleared, CSTS.RDY becomes zero once ready to be re-enabled.

assumptions.statement: NVM Subsystem Shutdown and controller shutdown are absent.
Continuously enabled readiness transitions eventually occur; CAP.TO timing is abstracted away.
Ghost histories are bounded by MaxWork, tested at 2, and Admin Queue properties use two opaque values.

exclusions.statement: Transport-specific state and behavior are not modeled.
Full Controller Level Reset effects beyond CC.EN, CSTS.RDY, and Admin Queue property preservation are excluded.
Host writes identified by the source as producing undefined results are excluded.
Shutdown-specific CC.EN and CSTS.RDY behavior is excluded.
CSTS.CFS and fatal-error behavior are excluded.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: CAP.TO and referenced timing sections were not supplied; no real-time bound is claimed.
Sections 3.7.2 and 3.7.2.1 were not supplied; detailed reset effects are not claimed.
